draft.shortGloss: to carry; to wear; to lead
draft.emotion: helpful and ready, stepping forward with a load
notes: Use portare when you are moving something from one place to another, whether in your hands or wearing it on your body.
Unlike English, Italian uses portare both for carrying things and for wearing clothes or accessories.

senses.definition: Trasportare qualcosa da un luogo a un altro, tenendolo con sé.

examples.text: Devo portare questi documenti in ufficio.
examples.translation: I need to carry these documents to the office.
examples.emotion: focused and determined, getting the task done

senses.definition: Avere indosso abiti, scarpe o accessori.

examples.text: Oggi porto una giacca pesante perché fa freddo.
examples.translation: Today I am wearing a heavy jacket because it is cold.
examples.emotion: practical and comfortable, dressing for the weather

senses.definition: Guidare o accompagnare qualcuno verso una destinazione.

examples.text: Ti porto io alla stazione in macchina.
examples.translation: I will drive you to the station in the car.
examples.emotion: kind and obliging, offering a helpful favor
